title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4WEAR - Wearer
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4wear/Wearer. Any living organism that is sensed by a wearable device. Subclass of geo:SpatialObject and (LivingOrganism and isSensedBy some WearableDevice) per the SAREF4WEAR ontology (ETSI TS 103 410-9 clause 4.2.2). The ontology's WearerProperty/BiometricProperty grouping classes are not modelled as separate top-level entities: per explicit translation instruction, their named-individual measurement kinds (HeartRate, WearerTemperature) become directly-named open-vocabulary attributes on this entity instead -- see standard-metadata.yaml for the full rationale. The ontology itself notes (clause 4.2.6) that its list of named Property individuals 'does not aim to be exhaustive but to reflect the potential use of the ontology' (e.g. TS 103 410-9 Figure 8 instantiates an ad hoc ex:OxygenSaturation BiometricProperty not in the fixed individuals list), confirming this is meant as an open, extensible vocabulary rather than a closed enumeration.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'Wearer'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

location.description: GeoProperty. Model:'https://purl.org/geojson/vocab#Point'. Current geolocation of the wearer (it is a geo:SpatialObject).

isSensedBy.description: Relationship. Wearable device(s) sensing this wearer; definitional for the Wearer class (s4wear:isSensedBy). Links to one or more WearableDevice entities.

isActedBy.description: Relationship. Device(s) that can act upon this wearer, e.g. a haptic/vibration actuator (s4wear:isActedBy; declared in TS 103 410-9 Table 2, not yet in the published ttl). Links to one or more WearableDevice entities.

meansOfTransport.description: Property. Means of transport the wearer is currently using, if the wearable is placed on one (s4wear:meansOfTransport), e.g. 'bicycle', 'car', 'on foot'.

wearerAgeRange.description: Property. Age range of the wearer (s4wear:wearerAgeRange in the published ontology; the normative text's Table 3 calls the same property 'wearerRangeAge' -- both names are documented here as a known source inconsistency), e.g. '18-25', '65+'.

wearerStatus.description: Property. Status of the wearer (s4wear:wearerStatus). The ontology notes this 'could be a value extracted from a closed list of alternatives' without specifying one; treated here as an open vocabulary string, e.g. 'active', 'resting', 'alert'.

heartRate.description: Property. Heart rate of the wearer, in beats per minute. Open-vocabulary value standing in for the s4wear:HeartRate (BiometricProperty) named individual.

wearerTemperature.description: Property. Body temperature of the wearer, in degrees Celsius. Open-vocabulary value standing in for the s4wear:WearerTemperature (BiometricProperty) named individual.
